purpose: Example brief for a SaaS product site. It shows the shape and the defaults only. Every idea-specific value below belongs to a made-up product and must be replaced by what the person says in the interview.

site.name: Tallyfold
site.one_liner: Expense reports that fill themselves in for small finance teams.

audience.icp: Finance leads at companies of 20 to 200 people who chase receipts every month-end.
audience.alternatives: Spreadsheets, shared inboxes, and expense tools that need every receipt keyed in.
frustrations: Close takes days instead of hours

blocks.headline: Month-end, without the chase.
blocks.subheadline: Tallyfold matches every card charge to a receipt and a category, so your team stops hunting for paperwork.

blocks.label: Concept preview
blocks.description: A mock-up of a month's charges, each matched to a receipt, with two unmatched items highlighted.

items.title: Connect your cards
items.text: Add the cards your team already uses.

items.title: Forward receipts
items.text: Email or photograph them. We match each to a charge.

items.title: Review and export
items.text: Approve the matches and send the file to your accountant.

blocks.heading: What Tallyfold reads, and what it never touches
never: Money movement. Tallyfold cannot send or move funds.
blocks.note: Only claims marked confirmed in the brief appear here; the block is left out otherwise.

items.quote: Example quote. Replace with a real one from the owner.
items.name: Example Name

blocks.headline: Close the books faster.
blocks.subheadline: Leave your email and we will be in touch.

blocks.tagline: Expense reports that fill themselves in.

signup.privacy_note: We will only email you about Tallyfold.

claims.text: Tallyfold reads card transactions read-only and cannot move money.

rules: No stock or generated photos or screenshots are fetched or invented.
The product visual starts as a designed mock-up labelled 'Concept preview'.
Logos and screenshots are added later by the owner.

look.accent_note: Choose one accent that suits a precise, calm finance brand and record it.

owner.sign_in: One owner, from environment configuration. The email and password hash are supplied when the site is deployed.
owner.page_editing: None in this version. Changes to the page are made by asking the builder.

stack: See the Builder's knowledge/stack.json. Those decisions are fixed.
not_in_this_version: An owner screen for editing the page
Customer logos or user counts unless the owner supplies them
assumptions: Everything about Tallyfold is made up for this example.
The success message is a default; the person can change it.
owner_vision: A finance lead should feel calm and in control, and leave their email to see it work. It should never feel like a bank or promise anything about moving money.
